Black's uncastled king cannot escape the barrage of forcing checks, and White's pieces coordinate to deliver mate or win material decisively.

**Coaching note:**
Always hunt exposed kings in the center. Black's failure to castle leaves the king vulnerable to a forcing queen dance. After Qd8+, successive checks (Qe8+, Qd7+) push the king forward into a mating net where escape squares are cut off by White's pieces and pawns. Uncastled kings make tempting tactical targets.
